description: This line plot illustrates how three distinct accuracy metrics—Final Accuracy, Δ Accuracy, and Initial Accuracy—vary as a function of Initial Confidence, which is plotted on the x-axis using a linear scale ranging from 0.81 to 0.99, with tick marks at every 0.01 increment except for 0.83. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy,” is also linear and spans from 0.0 to 1.0, marked at intervals of 0.2. The blue solid line with square markers, labeled “Final Accuracy,” begins at approximately 1.0 when Initial Confidence is 0.81, remains relatively stable near the 0.90–1.0 range across most of the x-axis, dips slightly near 0.86 and 0.90, and ends just above 0.98 at 0.99. The orange dashed line with diamond markers, labeled “Δ Accuracy,” starts at approximately 0.45 at 0.81, drops sharply to about 0.15 near 0.86, rises again to around 0.35 near 0.88, then declines steadily to approximately 0.05 by 0.99. The green dashed line with circular markers, labeled “Initial Accuracy,” begins at about 0.55 at 0.81, fluctuates between approximately 0.50 and 0.75 through the middle of the range, and rises steeply toward the end, reaching approximately 0.95 at 0.99. All three lines are accompanied by vertical error bars at each data point, indicating measurement variability; the blue line generally exhibits the smallest error bars, while the orange and green lines show larger, more variable error margins. A legend at the top of the plot clearly associates each line style and marker with its corresponding label.
caption_used: This line plot illustrates the relationship between different accuracies and initial confidence. The x-axis is labeled 'Initial Confidence,' with a linear scale ranging from approximately 0.81 to 0.99, with tick intervals at every 0.01 except 0.83. The y-axis is labeled 'Accuracy,' also on a linear scale, with a range from 0.0 to 1.0, marked at intervals of 0.2. There are three lines: a blue solid line with square markers representing 'Final Accuracy,' which starts near 1.0 at an initial confidence of 0.81, maintains a relatively high level throughout, and ends slightly above 1.0 at 0.99. An orange dashed line with diamond markers represents 'Δ Accuracy,' starting around 0.45, showing consistent growth throughout, and finally rising to approximately 0.3. Lastly, a green dashed line with circular markers represents 'Initial Accuracy,' beginning approximately 0.55 at an initial confidence of 0.81, fluctuating in value, and finally stabilizing near 0.95. Each line visually presents changes in accuracy corresponding to initial confidence values. All three lines include error bars, indicating variability at each data point, with the blue line having the least variability for most of the data points. There are legends provided on top of the plot to match different line styles to their labels.
